concerns.text: Task T1236 [P] 'Validate that the acquired datasets (from T011) meet the power requirement calculated in T1235' is marked completed before task T011 (dataset acquisition) is even defined. This violates the producer‑before‑consumer rule: T1236 consumes the datasets produced by T011, so it must be scheduled after T011 (or at least remain pending until T011 completes).
